title: Token Efficiency: Mubit vs Full Context Replay
description: Cumulative input tokens over N sequential tasks. Growth model calibrated to the measured CL-Bench suite: at N=6 the curves reproduce the measured values exactly (ICL 43.4M vs Mubit 7.2M, -83.5%). Replay re-sends all prior task history each time (quadratic); Mubit retrieves a fixed lesson block per task (linear).
